sample_unit: patient questions with paired chatbot and ophthalmologist answers

links.outcome: Masked ophthalmologist panel rating of chatbot vs human answers for incorrect information and harm
links.effect: Chatbot answers comparable to human answers for incorrect/inappropriate material (PR 0.92; 95% CI 0.77-1.10), likelihood of harm (PR 0.84; 0.67-1.07), extent of harm (PR 0.99; 0.80-1.22).
links.quote: The likelihood of chatbot answers containing incorrect or inappropriate material was comparable with human answers (PR, 0.92; 95% CI, 0.77-1.10), and did not differ from human answers in terms of likelihood of harm (PR, 0.84; 95% CI, 0.67-1.07) nor extent of harm (PR, 0.99; 95% CI, 0.80-1.22).

screen.reason: Empirical reader study comparing ChatGPT-generated responses to ophthalmologist-written responses for patient questions, evaluated by an expert clinician panel for accuracy and harm. It does not test a deployment practice or guardrail.
